sources.title: GROMACS mdrun performance guide
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: LAMMPS：溫控自由度與偏置速度稽核
related.titleEn: LAMMPS: thermostat degrees of freedom and velocity-bias audit
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有速度與科學契約同時合格才接受；保留原配置可回復。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept only joint timing and science compliance, and preserve the original configuration for reversal.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「LAMMPS：溫控自由度與偏置速度稽核」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付速度與動能帳本、自由度扣除表、兩種反例與溫控設定審查紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Investigate LAMMPS: thermostat degrees of freedom and velocity-bias audit using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a velocity and energy ledger, a degree-of-freedom subtraction table, two diagnostic counterexamples and a thermostat configuration review that distinguishes temperature definition from temperature regulation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分別寫出 6/2 的 12、20 ms 與 4/4 的 18、10 ms；加 3 ms 後比較，而不是把支線時間相加。
將已去質心的 K=18 代入公式；同時計算錯用 f=12 的結果，解釋 3 與 4 的差異源於定義。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate PP and PME times separately for both allocations. Identify which branch determines each join, add the fixed exchange once, and compare the resulting times without summing concurrent branch durations.

Insert unbiased K=18 into the temperature formula. Also compute the deliberately incorrect result obtained with twelve degrees of freedom and explain why the discrepancy is caused by inconsistent definitions rather than an integration failure.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WRF：巢狀網格時間鐘與 Courant 篩檢
related.titleEn: WRF: nested-grid clocks and a Courant screening contract
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有速度與科學契約同時合格才接受；保留原配置可回復。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Accept only joint timing and science compliance, and preserve the original configuration for reversal.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「WRF：巢狀網格時間鐘與 Courant 篩檢」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付父子時間線、無因次數表、同步反例與模式適用範圍說明。
related.differenceEn: Investigate WRF: nested-grid clocks and a Courant screening contract using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver parent-child timelines, dimensionless-number tables, a synchronization counterexample and a scope statement separating the screening exercise from a full weather-model validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分別寫出 6/2 的 12、20 ms 與 4/4 的 18、10 ms；加 3 ms 後比較，而不是把支線時間相加。
算十五秒內移動 900 m，再除子格寬；獨立計父網格的同一指標。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate PP and PME times separately for both allocations. Identify which branch determines each join, add the fixed exchange once, and compare the resulting times without summing concurrent branch durations.

Calculate travel of 900 m during a child step and divide by child spacing. Independently compute the parent indicator and explain why proportional refinement preserves this particular horizontal transport ratio.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
